name: @letbuyy/lcis-decision
description: LDSS — Decision Support System. Read-only, deterministic decision intelligence that composes ALL prior LCIS systems into structured recommendations: for a deploy/migration/rollback/scaling/business/architecture decision it generates strategy alternatives, scores them on risk/cost/readiness/blast-radius tradeoff axes, resolves the affected surface (systems/services/tables/apis/workers/domains) via the dependency twin, and recommends — with evidence, confidence, alternatives, and tradeoffs. It NEVER executes, deploys, or acts; it only recommends.
